202.acip: NGAG RTZUB PO'I NI, SA PHYOGS SDONG DUM DANG TSER MA DANG RDO DANG GSEG MA DANG GYO MO MANG BA DANG RTZUB PA DANG MDANGS MI SNUM PA DANG 'BAB CHU DANG MTSO DANG LTENG KA MED PA DANG SKAMS DANG TSVA RGO DANG DGON DUNG DANG THA CHAD DANG SDIG PA CAN GYI SA GZHI DANG 'JIGS PA'I RGYU MANG PO DANG LDAN PA DANG ,
202.wylie: ngag rtsub po'i ni, sa phyogs sdong dum dang tsher ma dang rdo dang gseg ma dang gyo mo mang ba dang rtsub pa dang mdangs mi snum pa dang 'bab chu dang mtsho dang lteng ka med pa dang skams dang tshva rgo dang dgon dung dang tha chad dang sdig pa can gyi sa gzhi dang 'jigs pa'i rgyu mang po dang ldan pa dang
202.english: Because you have spoken harsh words, the ground where you live is covered with obstacles like the trunks of fallen trees, and thorns, and stones, and clods of dirt, and lots of sharp broken pieces of glass; it's rough, and dreary; no streams, or lakes, or springs of water; the whole earth is parched, poisoned with salt and borax, burning hot, useless, threatening; a place where there are many things to fear.

203.acip: TSIG KYAL BA'I NI, 'BRAS BU'I LJON SHING LA 'BRAS BU MI 'CHAGS PA DANG DUS MIN PAR YANG 'BRAS BU 'CHAGS PA DANG DUS SU MI 'CHAGS PA DANG MA SMIN PA SMIN PAR SNANG BA DANG RTZA BA MI BRTAN PA DANG RING DU MI GNAS PA DANG KUN DGA' RA BA'AM NAGS TSAL LAM RDZING BU NYAMS DGA' BA MI MANG BA DANG 'JIGS PA'I RGYU MANG PO DANG LDAN PA DANG ,
203.wylie: tshig kyal ba'i ni, 'bras bu'i ljon shing la 'bras bu mi 'chags pa dang dus min par yang 'bras bu 'chags pa dang dus su mi 'chags pa dang ma smin pa smin par snang ba dang rtsa ba mi brtan pa dang ring du mi gnas pa dang kun dga' ra ba'am nags tshal lam rdzing bu nyams dga' ba mi mang ba dang 'jigs pa'i rgyu mang po dang ldan pa dang
203.english: Because you have talked meaninglessly, fruits refuse to grow on the trees, or they start to grow at the wrong times, never at the right times, and seem ripe when they're still not ripe, or their roots are frail, or they can't stay long; there are no places to take your leisure, no parks, no glades, no pools of cool water, and many things around to make you afraid.

204.acip: BRNAB SEMS KYI NI, PHUN SUM TSOGS PA THAMS CAD LO RE RE DANG DUS TSIGS DANG ZLA BA DANG ZHAG RE RER YANG NYAMS SHING 'BRI LA 'PHEL BA NI MIN PA DANG ,
204.wylie: brnab sems kyi ni, phun sum tshogs pa thams cad lo re re dang dus tshigs dang zla ba dang zhag re rer yang nyams shing 'bri la 'phel ba ni min pa dang
204.english: Because you have coveted what others have, then each and every good thing you ever manage to find starts to get worse, and less and less, never more, each one of them, with the passing of each of the four seasons, and in every month, and even day by day.
